texts.zh:
在[FromFrom.GetName]表面探测到一个小型研究站发出的信号，但[Root.Owner.GetName]既没有这个研究站的成立记录也没有对其授权记录。里面只有一位[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]科学家，如果在[FromFrom.GetName]的研究可信的话，平心而论确实是一位颇有才华且成果丰硕的研究者。但其身份存在一个问题，我们无法在帝国正式记录匹配到相关信息，此人也拒绝公开身份，只说自己是一个“流亡者”。

其表达了回到[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]直接为[Root.Owner.GetName]服务的愿望，条件是[Root.GetName]立刻离开[FromFrom.GetName]，并且任何[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]飞船都不能返回那里。
texts.en:
The readings originate from a small research outpost - which the [Root.Owner.GetName] has no records of establishing or indeed authorizing - on the surface of [FromFrom.GetName]. It is staffed by one [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] scientist, a fairly talented and industrious one if their research on [FromFrom.GetName] is anything to go by. There is a problem with regards to their identity however; we have been unable to match them against official state records, and they refuse to identify themselves save for stating that they are "an exile."

They have expressed an interest in returning to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] and serving the [Root.Owner.GetName] directly, on the condition that the [Root.GetName] immediately depart [FromFrom.GetName] and no [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] ships ever return there.

label.zh: 想都别想。给我把那个研究站翻个底朝天。
label.en: Out of the question. Search every nook and cranny of that outpost.
The [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] welcomes the exile back into the fold.

texts.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]上的研究站有点不寻常。建筑本身并无奇怪之处——用来对抗严酷环境的小型临时庇护所，仅能在严酷的环境拖垮之前，进行时间有限的表面级的星球研究——但它恰巧建在突破星球表面冰海的岩石之上。

[Root.GetName]的成员发现，这座山的内部有复杂的洞穴和通道，由研究站内部便可进入。

在一个较大的岩洞里，他们发现了研究站原成员脱水的遗体。这些[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]研究员原先被派往别处，但显然，他们却来到了这个无人居住的危险行星。

当然，那个所谓的“流亡者”如今已经不见踪影。[Root.GetName]发射了一所逃生舱，将逝者的遗体送回[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]。
texts.en:
There is something unusual about the research outpost on [From.From.From.GetName]. The structure itself is commonplace enough - a temporary shelter erected against the harsh elements, allowing surface-level planetary study for a limited time before it wears down and conditions become untenable - but it is situated on top of a rocky formation poking through the sea of ice that covers the planet.

The crew of the [Root.GetName] found an intricate system of caves and narrow passages leading into this mountain, accessible from inside the research outpost.

In one of the larger cavern-halls, they found the desiccated remains of the outpost's original staff. This contingent of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] researchers had originally been dispatched elsewhere, but evidently diverted to this uninhabited and hostile planet to set up shop.

Of course, the self-proclaimed "exile" is now nowhere to be found. The [Root.GetName] has launched one of its escape pods, transporting the bodies of the deceased back to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

texts.zh:
研究站本身没什么特别。它规模很小，只是用来对抗严酷环境的一个临时庇护所，仅能在严酷的环境拖垮之前，进行时间有限的表面级的星球研究。

[From.From.From.GetName]的研究站已经接近生命的尽头，但那颗星球的严寒还未压下最后一根稻草。那些功能正常、廉价且可抛弃的器材得到了充分使用，本地数据库中填满了详尽却极为寻常的行星数据，以及在严酷环境下进行的简单试验。

有趣的是，似乎研究站地基下的矿脉并没有得到深入检查。[Root.GetName]的扫描表明这座大部分被冰雪覆盖的山脉可能是中空的。更令人警觉的是，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告这座研究站唯一的栖居者，那位神秘的“流亡者”消失不见了。
texts.en:
There is nothing unusual about the research outpost itself. It is little but a temporary shelter erected against the savage elements, allowing surface-level planetary study for a limited time before it wears down and conditions become untenable.

The outpost on [From.From.From.GetName] is nearing the end of its lifespan, but the planet's intense chill has yet to critically degrade the impermanent structure. The equipment - functional, cheap, intended to be abandoned - is well-used, and the local databanks are filled with detailed but ultimately mundane accounts of the planet as well as the simple experiments that were carried out in its harsh environment.

Curiously, no closer examination seems to have been made of the mineral outcropping the outpost's foundations rest on; scans by the [Root.GetName] indicate that the geological formation, a mountain mostly buried under ice, may be partially hollow. More alarmingly, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the sole inhabitant of the outpost, the mysterious "exile," has gone missing and is nowhere to be found.

texts.zh:
科研船[Root.GetName]找不到我们在[From.From.GetName]上探测到的奇怪读数的来源，这些读数似乎只是传感器的回声。不过，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]——一位自称的美食家和历史爱好者——声称在那里有了重大发现。

在几块巨大的地表冰层中发现的矿藏似乎与[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]星盐关系密切：星盐曾经是许多传统[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]菜肴中不可或缺的调料，但长期以来一直被认为在[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上已经枯竭。

烹饪史学家长期以来一直怀疑这种矿物调味品不是我们母星的原产物，而科学专员在[From.From.GetName]上的发现则为这一理论提供了一些支持。至于这种盐的味道是否真的像以前的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]星盐，这并不是最重要的：仅仅是用如此相近的调味料恢复传统食品的想法，就一定会让我们的经济和味觉非常兴奋。
texts.en:
Science ship [Root.GetName] could find no source for the strange readings we detected on [From.From.GetName], which appear to be mere sensor echoes. Nevertheless, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] - a self-proclaimed gourmet chef and history buff - claims to have made a significant discovery there.

A mineral deposit found in several vast patches of surface ice appears closely related to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] Stellar Salt: once an essential ingredient in many traditional [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] dishes, long thought depleted on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

Culinary historians have long suspected that this mineral condiment was not native to our homeworld, and the Science Officer's discovery on [From.From.GetName] lends some credence to this theory. Whether or not the salt actually tastes like the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] Stellar Salt of old is ultimately of little consequence: the mere idea of reviving traditional foodstuffs with such closely-matched ingredients is bound to excite our economy and our palates.
